evidence_summary: This region contains the U1-type zinc finger, RRM, RS region, and recurrent cardiomyopathy localization/splicing hotspot variants.
caveat: Not a protein-partner interaction. Use only as domain/local-confidence context if AF3 output is structured and interpretable.

evidence_summary: RRM is the canonical RNA-recognition domain and sits near disease-relevant regions.
caveat: No RNA included; cannot claim RNA-binding interface without RNA design.

evidence_summary: UniProt annotates a matrin-type zinc finger at 1161-1192 and a disease-associated 1031-1227 truncation region.
caveat: C-terminal region may be disordered and may not generate useful AF3 features.

evidence_summary: RBM20 binds the 5-UCUU-3 motif in intronic pre-mRNA and regulates TTN, CACNA1C, CAMK2D, and PDLIM5 splicing.
caveat: Need explicit RNA length/context and AlphaFold Server RNA JSON schema before generating upload JSON.

evidence_summary: UniProt says RBM20 associates with components of U1 and U2 snRNP complexes.
caveat: No specific curated protein components selected; full snRNP complexes are too large and methodologically complex.

evidence_summary: Local IntAct hits are mostly high-throughput/two-hybrid/proximity candidates and not convincing cardiac RBM20 mechanism partners.
caveat: Do not promote to AF3 partners without targeted cardiac/RNA-splicing validation.
